findings.description: Permits filed for a minor residential expansion of 228 4th Avenue: an additional floor and dwelling behind the retained street facade, yielding a three-story structure of about 3,860 sq ft with two two-bedroom apartments. The existing wood-frame structure predates 1906; age-eligible, not a determined historic resource.

extra.proposal: add a floor and a dwelling; three stories, ~3,860 sq ft, two 2-bedroom units

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Minor Expansion For 228 4th Avenue in Inner Richmond, San Francisco,” 15 November 2026

raw.text: Permits have been filed for a minor residential expansion of 228 4th Avenue in San Francisco’s Inner Richmond neighborhood.
